name: username-ai-platform
description: AI-powered username and brand name discovery & monitoring SaaS

scripts.build: npm run build -w @username/shared && npm run build -w @username/checker-engine && npm run build -w @username/ai-engine && npm run build -w @username/db && npm run build -w @username/api && npm run build -w @username/bot && npm run build -w @username/miniapp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @username/shared && npm run typecheck -w @username/checker-engine && npm run typecheck -w @username/ai-engine && npm run typecheck -w @username/db && npm run typecheck -w @username/api && npm run typecheck -w @username/bot && npm run typecheck -w @username/miniapp
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules packages/*/dist packages/*/node_modules apps/*/dist apps/*/node_modules
